name: ledger
description: Ledger, a double-entry ledger in the style of TigerBeetle, in Lean: an HTTP API and an account view compiled to WebAssembly by Lasm, with proofs

scripts.build:bun: bunx --bun lasm build ServerBun.lean --target bun --output dist/server
scripts.build:docker: npm run build && docker build -t ledger .
scripts.build:lambda: npm run build && lasm package dist/server --target lambda
scripts.build:lambda-image: npm run build && docker build -f deploy/lambda-image/Dockerfile -t ledger-lambda:local .
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build && lasm package dist/server --target vercel
scripts.build:netlify: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist/public',{recursive:true})" && npm run build && lasm package dist/server --target netlify
scripts.build:azure: npm run build && node deploy/package-hosted.mjs azure
scripts.build:gcf: npm run build && node deploy/package-hosted.mjs gcf
